text: {"label":"Assessment and Treatment of Sleep Problems","definition":"Measuring, assessing, and treating sleep problems such as night waking, co-sleeping, and poor sleep hygiene, mostly in children with autism or developmental disabilities, including safe infant sleep and sleep's effects on challenging behavior.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on sleep as the target behavior, whereas neighbours cover general pediatric healthcare applications, broad autism intervention outcomes, or applied behavior analysis services for autism generally."}
